prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing pixel-art RPG farmhouse interior game background, furniture-only edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve its exact room silhouette, cutaway camera, framing, wall posts, window, lighting, floor, doorway, and EVERY EXISTING TABLE, STOOL, CABINET, BASKET in exactly their present position and dimensions. Existing empty tabletop surfaces remain completely empty for runtime collectible overlays.
Primary request: furnish the previously empty upper back section so the farmer home has a modest wooden bed with cream linen and muted green blanket, a short rustic wooden-and-cloth room divider screening the bed, and a small stone cooking fireplace with suspended iron pot and stacked firewood.
Placement coordinates below use the final LOGICAL canvas 640x360; scale proportionally to input dimensions. Add the bed against the upper LEFT wall: bounding rectangle x75..196,y64..116. Its footboard stops before y120. Add the low room divider immediately to the RIGHT of this bed: rectangle x202..225,y58..115. Add a small stone cooking fireplace/hearth against the upper BACK wall center: rectangle x279..359,y53..116, with shallow footprint ending before y120. Add a few tied herb bundles on the upper wall near hearth, one small wall-mounted pan and one modest folded linen atop bed. Very small warm glowing coals, hearth sits on stone with iron pot, no bright large flames or smoke.
Critical invariants: all new floor-contact furniture ends at y116, leaving y120..330 central walkable floor and all current approaches UNCHANGED. Existing medicine table at (110,145), clothes stool at (110,216), book table at (289,163), food counter at (431,138), water shelf at (518,140), cabinet at (551,201), door at (310,306) remain exact, as do their pixel surfaces and silhouettes. Do not place any new object on these tables or approaches. Do not move, erase, resize, add duplicates or decorate any existing furniture.
Style: match the target's dense grounded medieval pixel art, warm subdued earth palette, no blur, no painted brushwork, square pixel clusters, same elevated three-quarter view and scale.
Keep the exact image proportions, no crop or added margins, full-bleed. No characters, people, animals, corpses, bones, blood, new doors, text, signs, letters, labels, interface, watermark or magical effects.

Use case: precise-object-edit. The supplied image is an edit target. Perform ONE tiny adjustment only: move the entire bed (at upper left) 10 logical pixels UP, and move the entire cloth-and-wood divider 4 logical pixels UP. Logical canvas is640x360 so10pixels means2.78% of total image height. Current bed's feet reach logical y128; after shift its lowest foot pixel must be y118 or smaller. Reconstruct only small newly exposed floor strips. This keeps bed outside game's walkable y120..330 region. Keep the fireplace, its pottery and herbs, every existing table, stool, cupboard, window, walls, beams, floor, light, shadows and doorway EXACTLY in place. Preserve the image dimensions, style and pixel details. No added or removed objects. No crop.

reference_roles.original: Edit target preserving all interactive furniture positions
reference_roles.correction: First generated image; raise bed and divider outside walk floor

processing.method: Copy visually approved PNG source bytes unchanged; Phaser fits background to logical 640x360.

self_review.details: Modest linen bed, cloth divider, stone cooking fireplace with hanging iron pot, stacked firewood, pan, dried herbs and pottery occupy the rear wall strip. Existing medicine, clothing, books, food, water and cupboard furniture and doorway keep their positions. Empty pickup surfaces retained.
known_limitations: Precise source pixels may differ slightly after generative edit; all gameplay furniture positions reviewed visually. Live runtime integration and browser validation are performed by the coordinating agent.
